# sentry_organization_data_scrubbing (Resource)

Sentry Organization Data Scrubbing resource. Manages the data scrubbing settings that apply to every project of an existing organization, including Advanced Data Scrubbing rules. Omitted attributes are reset to the Sentry defaults, and destroying the resource resets every setting to the Sentry defaults. Project-level settings are attributes of `sentry_project`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sentry_organization_data_scrubbing" "default" {
  organization = "my-organization"

  data_scrubber          = true
  data_scrubber_defaults = true
  scrub_ip_addresses     = true
  sensitive_fields       = ["email", "phone"]
  safe_fields            = ["order_id"]

  # [Mask] [Credit card numbers] from [$message] and [Remove] [Anything] from [extra.foo]
  relay_pii_config = jsonencode({
    rules = {
      "0" = { type = "creditcard", redaction = { method = "mask" } }
      "1" = { type = "anything", redaction = { method = "remove" } }
    }
    applications = {
      "$message"  = ["0"]
      "extra.foo" = ["1"]
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) The slug or internal ID of the organization.

### Optional

- `data_scrubber` (Boolean) Require server-side data scrubbing for all projects. Defaults to `false`.
- `data_scrubber_defaults` (Boolean) Require the default scrubbers, which prevent things like passwords and credit cards from being stored, for all projects. Defaults to `false`.
- `relay_pii_config` (String) Advanced data scrubbing rules, as a JSON string holding the `rules` and `applications` objects. Build it with `jsonencode()`. The value replaces all advanced data scrubbing rules. For details, see [Advanced Data Scrubbing](https://docs.sentry.io/security-legal-pii/scrubbing/advanced-datascrubbing/). These rules apply to all projects. Omit it to remove all rules.
- `safe_fields` (Set of String) Field names which data scrubbers should ignore for all projects. Defaults to an empty set.
- `scrub_ip_addresses` (Boolean) Prevent IP addresses from being stored for new events in all projects. Defaults to `false`.
- `sensitive_fields` (Set of String) Additional field names to match against when scrubbing data for all projects. Defaults to an empty set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import using the organization slug from the URL:
# https://sentry.io/settings/[org-slug]/security-and-privacy/
terraform import sentry_organization_data_scrubbing.default org-slug
```
